statements.quote: The primary components included $22.4 million in depreciation and amortization expense on our operational AI Factories at our Polaris Forge 1 campus, $13.3 million in expenses which are reimbursable as tenant recoveries, and $7.8 million in personnel and other operating costs supporting our facilities.
statements.notes: Amount covers only the three months ended August 31, 2026 (fiscal Q1 2027), not the full fiscal year; the period is stated in the preceding sentence, not in this one, so fiscal_year is null. It is depreciation and amortization within cost of revenues on AI Factory infrastructure, not R&D or headcount, so whether it counts as opex is ambiguous. The other components ($13.3M tenant-recoverable expenses, $7.8M personnel and facility costs) are not attributed to AI and are excluded.
